name: synapsejs-monorepo
description: SynapseJS monorepo: the Bun-only slice framework, its reference app and its starter template
author: Ismael Soilet <ismael.soilet@hotmail.com>

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules/synapsejs') && fs.existsSync('packages/synapse')) { try { fs.symlinkSync('../packages/synapse', 'node_modules/synapsejs', 'junction'); } catch(e){} }"
scripts.test:all: bun test packages/synapse/test && bun --cwd apps/crm test && bun --cwd examples/enterprise-crm test && bun --cwd examples/helpdesk-slices test && bun --cwd examples/helpdesk-conventional test && bun --cwd examples/enterprise-crm test:e2e
scripts.split: bun --cwd apps/crm split && bun --cwd examples/enterprise-crm split && bun --cwd examples/helpdesk-slices split
scripts.build: bun test packages/synapse/test && bun run packages/synapse/bin/synapse.ts check && bun --cwd examples/enterprise-crm skeleton && bun --cwd examples/enterprise-crm split && bun --cwd examples/helpdesk-slices split
